      "name": "kernel",

      "evidence": "Adds C API endpoints (`btck_chainstate_manager_validate_block`, `btck_coin_create`) and wrapper abstractions in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h` and `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds API support for block validation against caller-supplied coins without requiring an on-disk UTXO set. API completeness for validating blocks and transactions is central to enabling external users to build lightweight verifiers and alternative storage backends on the library."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures, policy, transaction acceptance, or eviction rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Not a member; the change focuses on kernel block validation and does not affect mempool logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and adds `ChainstateManager::ValidateBlock` in `src/validation.cpp` to run contextual checks and `ConnectBlock` in check-only mode.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds an execution path to validate blocks against caller-supplied coins via `CoinsViewBlock`. While primarily a kernel feature, introducing a new block-connection entrypoint interacts with consensus validation invariants (such as script execution caching and assumevalid handling), though it does not change standard block connection for the node."
    }
